description: The file is a PHP source code defining a controller class for managing marketplace functionalities within the OpenCart admin panel. It handles filtering, sorting, pagination, and communication with an external API for listing extensions and promotions.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: The class represents a controller for the marketplace section in the OpenCart admin, enabling interaction with marketplace extensions and promotions, including filtering, sorting, and API communication.

classes.name: ControllerMarketplaceMarketplace
classes.description: A controller class managing the admin marketplace and extension interactions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: The main method that loads language, sets the page title, processes filters and sorting parameters from the request, manages pagination, constructs API requests, and renders the marketplace view with fetched data.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Handles the main extension page logic, including rendering marketplace info.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Handles purchasing logic for marketplace extensions, including API call and permission checks.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading extension files via API calls.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to an extension by sending data to an external API and processing the response.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Retrieves comments for an extension, supporting pagination and replies.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Retrieves replies to a specific comment for an extension, supporting pagination.
